title: MCP: add library_set_linkage tool for AS2 exportForActionScript linkage
description: There is no library_set_linkage tool in the MCP surface or agent registry. AS2 linkage (exportForActionScript, linkageIdentifier, exportInFirstFrame) is only settable through the SymbolLinkageDialog GUI. Agents cannot set _root.attachMovie() linkage IDs programmatically. Fix: (1) Add a setSymbolLinkage action handler in registry.ts that takes {symbolId, linkageId, exportForActionScript, exportInFirstFrame} and calls model.setSymbolLinkage(). (2) Implement model.setSymbolLinkage() in timeline.ts or library.ts to update the symbol's linkage fields. (3) Register it as an MCP tool in vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts.
